title: Nature Paragraph
titleMy: သဘာဝ စာပိုဒ်
description: Type about nature. Build rhythm and consistency.

exercises.instruction: The forest is full of tall green trees and colorful flowers. A clear stream flows between the rocks. Birds sing sweet songs in the early morning. Nature gives us fresh air and calmness.
